574-3558-5006-8170.easyPrerequisites: You haven't cast a spell using Lurrus this turn if Crookshank Kobolds is starting in your graveyard.
574-3558-5006-8170.description:
Cast Crookshank Kobolds by paying {0}.
Flickering Hound triggers, blinking Lurrus.
Resolve the Crookshank Kobolds spell. Then, activate Vish Kal by sacrificing Crookshank Kobolds, putting a number of +1/+1 counters on Vish Kal equal to the sacrificed creature's power
Repeat.
574-3558-5006-8170.notes: Once Vish Kal has infinite +1/+1 counters, you may activate its last ability any number of times to reduce the toughnesses of any number of creatures to 0.

728-7841--5.description:
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing the creature with persist.
When that creature dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a -1/-1 counter on it due to Darksteel Angel
Resolve the Grimgrin ability.
Repeat.

512-1719-4188.easyPrerequisites: Accomplished Alchemist and Vizier of Tumbling Sands do not have summoning sickness.
512-1719-4188.notablePrerequisites: You have gained at least 2 life this turn.
512-1719-4188.description:
Activate Accomplished Alchemist by tapping it, adding at least {W}{W}
Activate Vizier of Tumbling Sands by tapping it, targeting Halo Fountain.
Holding priority, activate Halo Fountain by paying {W}{W}, tapping it, and untapping Vizier of Tumbling Sands and Accomplished Alchemist, causing you to draw a card.
Resolve the Vizier of Tumbling Sands ability, untapping Halo Fountain.
Repeat.
512-1719-4188.notes: Once you have drawn your library, you may instead forego activating Accomplished Alchemist's ability to activate Halo Fountain's first ability to create near-infinite 1/1 Citizen creature tokens.

1818-1981-2415-4050.easyPrerequisites:
You control another creature.
You have 2 or more life.
1818-1981-2415-4050.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing a creature.
When the creature dies, Havoc Jester triggers, dealing 1 damage to you.
Darien triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
When the Soldier enters, Healer of the Pride triggers, causing you to gain life.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to any other creature you control

647-3259-7794.notablePrerequisites: At least one opponent cannot block creatures you control.
647-3259-7794.description:
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached and Koma, triggering Breath of Fury and Koma.
Resolve the Koma trigger, creating four creature tokens.
Resolve the Breath of Fury trigger, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to a creature token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one. 
Repeat each combat phase.

364-4499-7494.description:
Cast a copy of Seething Song from exile by paying {R}, adding {R}{R}{R}{R}{R}.
Activate Emiel the Blessed by paying {3}, blinking Blazing Firesinger, which enters prepared.
Repeat.

1765-3967-6888.description:
Cast Traveling Plague by paying {3}{B}{B}, attaching it to another creature you control.
When Traveling Plague enters, Chishiro triggers, creating a creature token.
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing the creature Traveling Plague is attached to.
When the creature dies, Traveling Plague triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to the token created in step 2.
When Traveling Plague enters, Chishiro triggers, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Yahenni ability.
Repeat from step 3.

950-4222-7069.description:
Activate a land by tapping it, adding {U}{U}{U} due to Tectonic Split
Activate Fatestitcher by tapping it, untapping Tectonic Split.
Activate Freed from the Real by paying {U}, untapping Fatestitcher.
Repeat.

1183-4851-4853.description:
Activate Timeless Lotus by tapping it, adding {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}
Activate Pentavus's first ability by paying {1} and removing a +1/+1 counter from it, creating a 1/1 Pentavite creature token.
Activate Pentavus's second ability by paying {1} and sacrificing the Pentavite.
When the Pentavite dies, Dross Scorpion triggers, untapping Timeless Lotus.
Resolve the Pentavus ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat.
1183-4851-4853.notes: Once you have enough mana, you can untap other artifacts using Dross Scorpion

654-681-5411-6621.easyPrerequisites: Lands you control excluding Mirrorpool can tap to produce at least {2}{C}
654-681-5411-6621.description:
Cast Splendid Reclamation by paying {3}{G}.
Holding priority, activate any number of lands you control except Mirrorpool by tapping them, adding at least {2}{C}.
Activate Need for Speed by sacrificing a land other than Mirrorpool.
Repeat step 3 until Mirrorpool is the only land you control.
Activate Mirrorpool's second ability by paying {2}{C}, tapping and sacrificing it, copying Splendid Reclamation.
Resolve the Splendid Reclamation copy, returning all land cards from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When the lands enter, Amulet of Vigor triggers that many times, untapping the lands.
Repeat from step 2.

413-4336-5220-6900.description:
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing Kobolds of Kher Keep
When Kobolds of Kher Keep dies, Mortuary triggers, putting Kobolds of Kher Keep from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Blasting Station ability.
Cast Kobolds of Kher Keep from the top of your library by paying 0 life.
When Kobolds of Kher Keep enters, Blasting Station triggers, untapping Blasting Station.
Repeat.

813-972-2792.easyPrerequisites: You control up to seven lands that can tap to produce at least {4}{U}{U}.
813-972-2792.description:
Activate up to seven lands by tapping them, adding at least {4}{U}{U}.
Cast Saheeli's Artistry by paying {4}{U}{U}, creating a token copy of Great Whale that is an artifact.
When the Great Whale token enters, it triggers, untapping up to seven lands.
Cast Scholar of the Ages by paying its mana cost.
When Scholar of the Ages enters, it triggers, returning Saheeli's Artistry from your graveyard to your hand.
Activate up to seven lands by tapping them, adding at least {4}{U}{U}.
Cast Saheeli's Artistry by paying {4}{U}{U}, creating a token copy of Scholar of the Ages and the Great Whale token.
When the Scholar of the Ages and Great Whale tokens enter, they trigger.
Resolve the Scholar of the Ages token's trigger, returning Saheeli's Artistry from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Great Whale token's trigger, untapping up to seven lands.
Repeat from step 6.
813-972-2792.notes: If the seven lands can tap to produce {5}{U}{U} or more, this combo will net infinite mana. So long as you produce an extra {U} each loop, you can eventually stop copying Great Whale and copy other creature(s) or artifact(s) instead. You can return other cards to your hand using Scholar of the Ages in addition to Saheeli's Artistry.

1456-5078-6259.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {0}.
Repeat

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to another creature you control

2279-5058-5256.description:
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing the creature that has Screams from Within attached.
When the creature dies, Screams from Within triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to another creature you control.
Quintorius triggers, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability.
Repeat.

2438-6014-6659.description:
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing another modified creature.
When the creature dies, Guardian of the Forgotten triggers, manifesting the top card of your library.
When the manifested card enters the battlefield, Gylwain triggers, creating a Role token attached to the manifested creature.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability.
Repeat.

1274-2034-3490-4716.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
1274-2034-3490-4716.description:
Gain life.
Heliod triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
When the Servo enters the battlefield, Prosperous Innkeeper triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Heliod triggers, holding priority, activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Servo, adding {C}{C}.
Resolve the Heliod trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control.
Repeat from step 3.

1636-4571-5996.easyPrerequisites: Tarmogoyf Nest does not have summoning sickness.
1636-4571-5996.notablePrerequisites: Creatures and/or lands you control can tap to produce at least {1}{G}.
1636-4571-5996.description:
Cast Life by paying {G}, causing lands you control to become a creature until end of turn.
Activate any number of creatures and/or lands you control by tapping them, adding at least {1}{G}.
Activate the land with Tarmogoyf Nest attached by paying {1}{G} and tapping it, creating a Tarmogoyf creature token.
When the Tarmogoyf enters the battlefield, Intruder Alarm triggers, untapping all creatures.
Repeat from step 2.

1267-3874-5459.notablePrerequisites:
You control at least one additional creature.
Armory Automaton cannot be blocked by an opponent
1267-3874-5459.description:
Declare Armory Automaton as an attacker.
Armory Automaton triggers, attaching Assimilation Aegis to it.
Assimilation Aegis' second ability triggers, causing Armory Automaton to become a copy of Medomai the Ageless.
Deal combat damage with Armory Automaton.
Armory Automaton triggers, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Move to your next turn.
Activate Assimilation Aegis' equip ability by paying {2}, attaching it to any other creature.
Assimilation Aegis' second ability triggers, causing the creature to become a copy of Medomai the Ageless.
Repeat.

1651-2645-4131-4563.notablePrerequisites: Everflowing Chalice has at least five charge counters on it.
1651-2645-4131-4563.description:
Activate Everflowing Chalice by tapping it, adding at least {C}{C}{C}{C}{C}.
Activate Clock of Omens by tapping Staff of Domination and Basalt Monolith, untapping Everflowing Chalice.
Activate Basalt Monolith's second ability by paying {3}, untapping it.
Activate Staff of Domination's first ability by paying {1}, untapping it.
Repeat.
Once you have infinite mana, you may use it to activate Staff of Domination's other abilities and/or untap any artifact(s) you control.

413-1020-3689-4766.description:
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing Myr Retriever.
Myr Retriever dies, triggering itself and Deathrender.
Resolve the Myr Retriever trigger, returning Workshop Assistant from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Deathrender trigger, putting Workshop Assistant from your hand onto the battlefield, and attaching Deathrender to it.
Workshop Assistant enters the battlefield, triggering Blasting Station, untapping Blasting Station.
Resolve the Blasting Station ability from step 1, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing Workshop Assistant.
Workshop Assistant dies, triggering itself and Deathrender.
Resolve the Workshop Assistant trigger, returning Myr Retriever from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Deathrender trigger, putting Myr Retriever from your hand onto the battlefield, and attaching Deathrender to it.
Myr Retriever enters the battlefield, triggering Blasting Station, untapping Blasting Station.
Resolve the Blasting Station ability from step 7, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Repeat.

1913-2558-3983-4659.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to cause a 2/2 creature to enter the battlefield under your control.
1913-2558-3983-4659.description:
Cause a 2/2 creature to enter the battlefield under your control, which enters as a 1/1 creature due to Night of Souls' Betrayal.
The creature enters the battlefield, triggering Sword of the Meek, returning Sword of the Meek from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to the creature.
Imotekh triggers, holding priority, activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing Sword of the Meek, adding {C}{C}.
Resolve the Imotekh trigger, creating two 2/2 Necron Warrior artifact creature tokens that enter the battlefield as 1/1 creatures due to Night of Souls' Betrayal.
Repeat from step 2.

518-4090.notablePrerequisites:
You control an indestructible creature that has Pariah attached to it.
You have a way to deal damage to the indestructible creature.
518-4090.description:
Cast Arcbond by paying {2}{R}, targeting the indestructible creature with Pariah attached.
Deal damage to the indestructible creature.
The creature triggers, dealing that much damage to each other creature and each player, with the damage that would be dealt to you instead being dealt to the indestructible creature due to Pariah.
Repeat step 3.

3756-4222-4348.notablePrerequisites:
Ley Druid does not have summoning sickness.
Freed from the Real attached to Ley Druid.
3756-4222-4348.description:
Activate Izzet Boilerworks by tapping it, adding {U}{R}.
Activate Ley Druid by tapping it, untapping Izzet Boilerworks.
Activate Freed from the Real's last ability by paying {U}, untapping Ley Druid.
Repeat any number of times.
